## Abuse Reports

### create

`abuseReports.create`

Reports a publicly shared resource, like a shared view or form, for abuse. This endpoint can be called by anonymous visitors.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.abuseReports.create({
	description: 'examplexxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx',
	email: 'ada@example.com',
	identifier: 'example',
	name: 'example',
	resource_type: 'database_view',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `resource_type` | `database_view \| builder \| dashboard` | Yes | The type of publicly shared resource that is being reported. * `database_view` - database_view * `builder` - builder * `dashboard` - dashboard |
| `identifier` | `string` | Yes | The public identifier of the reported resource, for example the slug of a publicly shared view. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | The name of the person reporting the abuse. |
| `email` | `string` | Yes | The email address of the person reporting the abuse. |
| `description` | `string` | Yes | A detailed description of why the resource is abusive. |
| `captcha_token` | `string` | No | The captcha response token, required when captcha is enabled. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

## Admin

### addUserToLicense

`admin.addUserToLicense`

Adds the user related to the provided parameter and to the license related to the parameter. This only happens if there are enough seats left on the license and if the user is not already on the license.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.addUserToLicense({ id: 1, user_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The internal identifier of the license, this is `id` and not `license_id`. |
| `user_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The ID of the user that must be added to the license. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `first_name` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `email` | `string \| string \| null` | No | — |

### approveUserTemplate

`admin.approveUserTemplate`

Approves a user template in review or rejected, if the requesting user is staff: the revision they reviewed is listed for everybody on this instance in place of the one listed until then. It must still be the revision under review, not reviewed since, have content, and not be edited since it was….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.approveUserTemplate({
	template_id: 1,
	listed: true,
	reviewed_on: 'example',
	revision_id: 1,
	state: 'private',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `template_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the template. |
| `revision_id` | `number` | Yes | The id of the revision the admin reviewed, which must still be the row of the template. |
| `state` | `private \| in_review \| rejected \| blocked \| public` | Yes | The state of the template the admin reviewed, which must still be its state. * `private` - Private * `in_review` - In review * `rejected` - Rejected * `blocked` - Blocked * `public` - Public |
| `listed` | `boolean` | Yes | Whether the template the admin reviewed was listed, which must still be so. |
| `reviewed_on` | `string \| null` | Yes | The `reviewed_on` of the revision the admin reviewed, which must still be its value. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `revision_id` | `number \| null` | No | The id of the serialized revision. Sent with an install, so that the template isn't installed if it was updated since. |
| `slug` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | Whether it's an official or a user template. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | The description of this revision. |
| `icon` | `string \| null` | No | The icon class name that can be used for displaying purposes. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The group containing the applications related to the template. The read endpoints related to that group are publicly accessible for preview purposes. Revisions of the same template that only differ in their details share it. |
| `open_application` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The application ID that must be opened when the template is previewed. If null, then the first will automatically be chosen. |
| `categories` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `author` | `object \| null` | No | The author of the template. Null if they were deleted. |
| `state` | `string \| null` | No | The tab of the admin page the template is on. * `private` - Private * `in_review` - In review * `rejected` - Rejected * `blocked` - Blocked * `public` - Public |
| `reason` | `any \| null \| null` | No | Why an admin rejected or blocked the template, for a rejected or blocked one. |
| `listed` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether a revision of the template is listed for everybody, also while a later one is in review or rejected. |
| `private_link` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the private link of the template is on. The link itself is never shown. |
| `can_approve` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether an admin can approve the revision: in review or rejected, with content, and not edited since it was submitted. |
| `edited_since_submitted` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the template was edited since the revision was submitted, which is why an admin can't approve it. |
| `updated_since_blocked` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the latest revision was made after the template was blocked; false outside the blocked tab. |
| `can_reject` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether an admin can reject the template: in review, or listed. |
| `reject_unlists` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether rejecting the template takes it out of the listing: when it's listed, unless only its edit is in review. |
| `updated_on` | `string \| null` | No | When the revision was made. |
| `reviewed_on` | `string \| null \| null` | No | When an admin, or a submit without review, last reviewed the revision. Null if never. |
| `install_count` | `number \| null` | No | How many times the template was installed. |
| `submitted_on` | `string \| null \| null` | No | When the revision was submitted for review, if it was. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="categories full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  name?: string | null,
  user_selectable?: boolean | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="author full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  first_name?: string | null,
  email?: string | string | null
} | null | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### blockUserTemplate

`admin.blockUserTemplate`

Blocks a user template in any state, if the requesting user is staff. Only its author and instance admins can open it, only instance admins can install or download it, its private link stops working, and its author sees the reason and can't change its visibility or private link. Nothing else….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.blockUserTemplate({ template_id: 1, reason: 'example', revision_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `template_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the template. |
| `revision_id` | `number` | Yes | The id of the revision the admin saw. For a blocked template it must still be its latest revision. |
| `reason` | `string` | Yes | Why the template is blocked, shown to its author. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `revision_id` | `number \| null` | No | The id of the serialized revision. Sent with an install, so that the template isn't installed if it was updated since. |
| `slug` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | Whether it's an official or a user template. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | The description of this revision. |
| `icon` | `string \| null` | No | The icon class name that can be used for displaying purposes. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The group containing the applications related to the template. The read endpoints related to that group are publicly accessible for preview purposes. Revisions of the same template that only differ in their details share it. |
| `open_application` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The application ID that must be opened when the template is previewed. If null, then the first will automatically be chosen. |
| `categories` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `author` | `object \| null` | No | The author of the template. Null if they were deleted. |
| `state` | `string \| null` | No | The tab of the admin page the template is on. * `private` - Private * `in_review` - In review * `rejected` - Rejected * `blocked` - Blocked * `public` - Public |
| `reason` | `any \| null \| null` | No | Why an admin rejected or blocked the template, for a rejected or blocked one. |
| `listed` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether a revision of the template is listed for everybody, also while a later one is in review or rejected. |
| `private_link` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the private link of the template is on. The link itself is never shown. |
| `can_approve` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether an admin can approve the revision: in review or rejected, with content, and not edited since it was submitted. |
| `edited_since_submitted` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the template was edited since the revision was submitted, which is why an admin can't approve it. |
| `updated_since_blocked` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the latest revision was made after the template was blocked; false outside the blocked tab. |
| `can_reject` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether an admin can reject the template: in review, or listed. |
| `reject_unlists` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether rejecting the template takes it out of the listing: when it's listed, unless only its edit is in review. |
| `updated_on` | `string \| null` | No | When the revision was made. |
| `reviewed_on` | `string \| null \| null` | No | When an admin, or a submit without review, last reviewed the revision. Null if never. |
| `install_count` | `number \| null` | No | How many times the template was installed. |
| `submitted_on` | `string \| null \| null` | No | When the revision was submitted for review, if it was. |

### checkLicense

`admin.checkLicense`

This endpoint checks with the authority if the license needs to be updated. It also checks if the license is operating within its limits and might take action on that. It could also happen that the license has been deleted because there is an instance id mismatch or because it's invalid. In that….

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.checkLicense({ id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The internal identifier of the license, this is `id` and not `license_id`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `license_id` | `string \| null` | No | Unique identifier of the license. |
| `is_active` | `boolean \| null` | No | Indicates if the backend deems the license valid. |
| `last_check` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `valid_from` | `string \| null` | No | From which timestamp the license becomes active. |
| `valid_through` | `string \| null` | No | Until which timestamp the license is active. |
| `free_users_count` | `number \| null` | No | The amount of free users that are currently using the license. |
| `seats_taken` | `number \| null` | No | The amount of users that are currently using the license. |
| `seats` | `number \| null` | No | The maximum amount of users that can use the license. |
| `application_users_taken` | `number \| null` | No | The amount of application builder users used so far in this license. |
| `application_users` | `number \| null` | No | The amount of application builder users permitted in this license. |
| `product_code` | `string \| null` | No | The product code that indicates what the license unlocks. |
| `issued_on` | `string \| null` | No | The date when the license was issued. It could be that a new license is issued with the same `license_id` because it was updated. In that case, the one that has been issued last should be used. |
| `issued_to_email` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates to which email address the license has been issued. |
| `issued_to_name` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates to whom the license has been issued. |
| `users` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="users full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  first_name?: string | null,
  email?: string | string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### countUserTemplates

`admin.countUserTemplates`

Returns how many user templates are in review, public, rejected, blocked and private, if the requesting user is staff.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.countUserTemplates({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `in_review` | `number \| null` | No | The templates in review. |
| `public` | `number \| null` | No | The listed templates without an edit in review or rejected. |
| `rejected` | `number \| null` | No | The rejected templates. |
| `blocked` | `number \| null` | No | The blocked templates. |
| `private` | `number \| null` | No | The private templates. |

### createUser

`admin.createUser`

Creates and returns a new user if the requesting user is staff. This works even if new signups are disabled.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.createUser({ name: 'example', password: 'example-password', username: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `username` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `is_active` | `boolean` | No | Designates whether this user should be treated as active. Set this to false instead of deleting accounts. |
| `is_staff` | `boolean` | No | Designates whether this user is an admin and has access to all workspaces and Baserow's admin areas. |
| `password` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `username` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `workspaces` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `last_login` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `date_joined` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `is_active` | `boolean \| null` | No | Designates whether this user should be treated as active. Set this to false instead of deleting accounts. |
| `is_staff` | `boolean \| null` | No | Designates whether this user is an admin and has access to all workspaces and Baserow's admin areas. |
| `two_factor_auth` | `object \| null` | No | The user's two factor auth provider state, or null when no provider is configured. |

### dataScanner.createScan

`admin.dataScanner.createScan`

Creates a new data scan. A data scan searches the Baserow instance for sensitive data matching a pattern (e.g. credit card numbers), a list of uploaded values, or values sourced from another Baserow table. Enterprise feature.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.dataScanner.createScan({ name: 'example', scan_type: 'pattern' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `scan_type` | `pattern \| list_of_values \| list_table` | Yes | * `pattern` - Pattern * `list_of_values` - List of values * `list_table` - List Table |
| `pattern` | `string` | No | — |
| `frequency` | `manual \| hourly \| daily \| weekly` | No | * `manual` - Manual * `hourly` - Hourly * `daily` - Daily * `weekly` - Weekly |
| `scan_all_workspaces` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `workspace_ids` | `number[]` | No | — |
| `list_items` | `string[]` | No | — |
| `source_table_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `source_field_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `whole_words` | `boolean` | No | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `scan_type` | `string \| null` | No | * `pattern` - Pattern * `list_of_values` - List of values * `list_table` - List Table |
| `pattern` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `frequency` | `string \| null` | No | * `manual` - Manual * `hourly` - Hourly * `daily` - Daily * `weekly` - Weekly |
| `scan_all_workspaces` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `workspace_ids` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `is_running` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `last_run_started_at` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `last_run_finished_at` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `last_error` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `list_items` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `results_count` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `source_table_id` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `source_field_id` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `whole_words` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `source_workspace_id` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `source_database_id` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `created_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `updated_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### dataScanner.exportResults

`admin.dataScanner.exportResults`

Creates a job to export data scan results to CSV. The exported file includes scan name, workspace, database, table, field, row ID, matched value, and timestamps for each result. Enterprise feature.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.dataScanner.exportResults({});
```

| `csv_column_separator` | `, \| ; \| \| \| tab \| record_separator \| unit_separator` | No | The value used to separate columns in the resulting csv file. * `,` - , * `;` - ; * `\|` - \| * `tab` - * `record_separator` - * `unit_separator` - |

| `csv_first_row_header` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether or not to generate a header row at the top of the csv file. |
| `filter_scan_id` | `number \| null` | No | Optional: Filter results by scan ID. |

### dataScanner.getScan

`admin.dataScanner.getScan`

Returns a single data scan configuration. Enterprise feature.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.dataScanner.getScan({ scan_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `scan_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### dataScanner.listResults

`admin.dataScanner.listResults`

Lists all data scan results across all scans. Results represent individual matches found in database fields during scan execution. Can be filtered by scan_id and searched by matched value. Enterprise feature.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.dataScanner.listResults({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string` | No | A comma-separated list of data scan results IDs to filter by. When provided, only data scan results with those IDs are returned. |
| `page` | `number` | No | Defines which page should be returned. |
| `search` | `string` | No | If provided only data scan results with matched_value that match the query will be returned. |
| `size` | `number` | No | Defines how many data scan results should be returned per page. |
| `sorts` | `string` | No | A comma separated string of attributes to sort by, each attribute must be prefixed with `+` for a descending sort or a `-` for an ascending sort. The accepted attribute names are: `first_identified_on, last_identified_on`. For example `sorts=-first_identified_on,-last_identified_on` will sort the data scan results first by descending first_identified_on and then ascending last_identified_on. A sortparameter with multiple instances of the same sort attribute will respond with the ERROR_INVALID_SORT_ATTRIBUTE error. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `count` | `number \| null` | No | The total amount of results. |
| `next` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the next page. |
| `previous` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the previous page. |
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>

```ts
{

  scan_id?: number | null,
  scan_name?: any | null,
  workspace_name?: any | null,
  database_id?: any | null,
  database_name?: any | null,
  table_id?: number | null,
  table_name?: any | null,
  field_name?: any | null,
```

### rejectUserTemplate

`admin.rejectUserTemplate`

Rejects a user template in review, or a listed one, if the requesting user is staff. A listed template is taken out of the listing, unless only its edit is in review: then only the edit is rejected. The revision they reviewed must still be the template's row, not reviewed since, and the state….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.admin.rejectUserTemplate({
	template_id: 1,
	listed: true,
	reason: 'example',
	reviewed_on: 'example',
	revision_id: 1,
	state: 'private',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `template_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the template. |
| `revision_id` | `number` | Yes | The id of the revision the admin reviewed, which must still be the row of the template. |
| `state` | `private \| in_review \| rejected \| blocked \| public` | Yes | The state of the template the admin reviewed, which must still be its state. * `private` - Private * `in_review` - In review * `rejected` - Rejected * `blocked` - Blocked * `public` - Public |
| `listed` | `boolean` | Yes | Whether the template the admin reviewed was listed, which must still be so. |
| `reviewed_on` | `string \| null` | Yes | The `reviewed_on` of the revision the admin reviewed, which must still be its value. |
| `reason` | `string` | Yes | Why the template is rejected, shown to its author. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `revision_id` | `number \| null` | No | The id of the serialized revision. Sent with an install, so that the template isn't installed if it was updated since. |
| `slug` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | Whether it's an official or a user template. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | The description of this revision. |
| `icon` | `string \| null` | No | The icon class name that can be used for displaying purposes. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The group containing the applications related to the template. The read endpoints related to that group are publicly accessible for preview purposes. Revisions of the same template that only differ in their details share it. |
| `open_application` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The application ID that must be opened when the template is previewed. If null, then the first will automatically be chosen. |
| `categories` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `author` | `object \| null` | No | The author of the template. Null if they were deleted. |
| `state` | `string \| null` | No | The tab of the admin page the template is on. * `private` - Private * `in_review` - In review * `rejected` - Rejected * `blocked` - Blocked * `public` - Public |
| `reason` | `any \| null \| null` | No | Why an admin rejected or blocked the template, for a rejected or blocked one. |
| `listed` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether a revision of the template is listed for everybody, also while a later one is in review or rejected. |
| `private_link` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the private link of the template is on. The link itself is never shown. |
| `can_approve` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether an admin can approve the revision: in review or rejected, with content, and not edited since it was submitted. |
| `edited_since_submitted` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the template was edited since the revision was submitted, which is why an admin can't approve it. |
| `updated_since_blocked` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the latest revision was made after the template was blocked; false outside the blocked tab. |
| `can_reject` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether an admin can reject the template: in review, or listed. |
| `reject_unlists` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether rejecting the template takes it out of the listing: when it's listed, unless only its edit is in review. |
| `updated_on` | `string \| null` | No | When the revision was made. |
| `reviewed_on` | `string \| null \| null` | No | When an admin, or a submit without review, last reviewed the revision. Null if never. |
| `install_count` | `number \| null` | No | How many times the template was installed. |
| `submitted_on` | `string \| null \| null` | No | When the revision was submitted for review, if it was. |

## Agents

### createAction

`agents.createAction`

Pins authenticated realtime recovery reads to the primary database. Realtime refresh markers are emitted after a primary-database snapshot. Reading their replacement data from a lagging replica could otherwise restore stale state in the client. Authentication is deliberately completed before….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.createAction({ agent_id: 1, type: 'example' });
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `name` | `string` | No | — |
| `description` | `string` | No | — |

### createConversation

`agents.createConversation`

Starts a private conversation with its first message. The conversation and message uuids identify the request, so a retry returns the already accepted message, and reusing a uuid with different content is rejected.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.createConversation({
	agent_id: 1,
	content: 'example',
	message_uuid: '3f0e6a2c-8b1d-4c7e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b6c',
	uuid: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | — |
| `content` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `message_uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `conversation` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `message` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `reply` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### createMessage

`agents.createMessage`

Adds a message to one of the authenticated user's conversations. The message uuid identifies the request, so a retry returns the already accepted message, and reusing it with different content is rejected.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.createMessage({
	agent_id: 1,
	conversation_uuid: '3f0e6a2c-8b1d-4c7e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b6c',
	content: 'example',
	uuid: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | — |
| `conversation_uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `content` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `conversation` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `message` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `reply` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### createTrigger

`agents.createTrigger`

Adds a trigger of one of the configuration's available_trigger_types to the agent, with initial values for its service. A configured service starts receiving events right away. Requires permission to update the agent and read its configuration.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.createTrigger({ agent_id: 1, type: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `type` | `string` | Yes | The service type of the trigger, one of the configuration's available_trigger_types. |
| `name` | `string` | No | The trigger's name, trimmed. Blank shows a default worded by its type, such as its schedule. |
| `message` | `Record<string, any>` | No | The formula, resolved against the trigger's payload, whose text opens each conversation the trigger starts. Empty opens it with the payload itself. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | No | Whether the trigger starts conversations right away. |
| `on_overlap` | `skip \| wait \| parallel` | No | What a firing does while a reply of the trigger is still going: `skip` starts nothing, `wait` queues its conversation until that reply ends, `parallel` starts it alongside, up to a cap, then queues it. Left out, it is `wait` for a type whose events can't be skipped, like changed rows, and `skip` otherwise. * `skip` - Skip * `wait` - Wait for the previous run * `parallel` - Run in parallel |
| `batch_size` | `number` | No | How many records of a list payload, such as created rows, each conversation receives: a larger event starts one conversation per batch. Payloads that aren't lists ignore it. |
| `service` | `object` | No | The service producing the trigger's events. |

### decideToolApprovals

`agents.decideToolApprovals`

Approves or rejects tool calls that the waiting reply of one of the authenticated user's conversations, or of a shared conversation a trigger started, holds for approval. Once none are left to decide, a run continues the reply and the response names it. With always_allow, the tools of the….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.decideToolApprovals({
	agent_id: 1,
	conversation_uuid: '3f0e6a2c-8b1d-4c7e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b6c',
	decisions: [{ approved: true, id: 1 }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `conversation_uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `decisions` | `object[]` | Yes | Decisions on pending approvals of the waiting reply, at most one per approval. The reply continues once none is pending. |
| `always_allow` | `boolean` | No | Whether the tools of the approved calls stop asking first. Needs the permissions to update the agent's configuration. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="decisions full type">

```ts
{
  id: number,
  approved: boolean,
  reason?: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `uuid` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `role` | `string \| null` | No | * `user` - User * `assistant` - Assistant * `trigger` - Trigger |
| `content` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `created_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `status` | `string \| any \| null \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `error_code` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `run_id` | `string \| null \| null` | No | The run writing this reply, to follow its output: set while it runs and in the response that started it. |
| `steps` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `approvals` | `object[] \| null` | No | The reply's held tool calls, joined to their steps by step_id, with the decision on each. |

### deleteConversation

`agents.deleteConversation`

Moves one of the authenticated user's conversations to the trash and stops the reply being written in it. Only the owner sees and restores it there.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.deleteConversation({ agent_id: 1, conversation_uuid: '3f0e6a2c-8b1d-4c7e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b6c' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `conversation_uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### deleteTrigger

`agents.deleteTrigger`

Moves the trigger to the trash, where it can be restored. Requires permission to update the agent and read its configuration.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.deleteTrigger({ agent_id: 1, trigger_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `trigger_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the trigger. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### getConfiguration

`agents.getConfiguration`

Returns the instructions, provider, model, reasoning effort and run-as identity of the agent, with its readiness and the fields that are missing or no longer available.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.getConfiguration({ agent_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `readiness` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `instructions` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `provider_type` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `model_identifier` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `reasoning_effort` | `string \| any \| null \| null \| null` | No | How much the model reasons before it replies. Null uses the model's default. * `off` - off * `low` - low * `medium` - medium * `high` - high |
| `applied_reasoning_effort` | `string \| any \| null \| null \| null` | No | The reasoning effort replies use with the selected model: the chosen one, or the next higher one the model accepts. Null means replies use the model's default, because none is chosen, the model doesn't accept one, or the model isn't available. * `off` - off * `low` - low * `medium` - medium * `high` - high |
| `run_as` | `object \| null` | No | The configured identity and its active, trashed or missing status. Null means no workspace access was selected. |
| `allowed_tools` | `string[] \| null` | No | The names of the tools the agent may call while it has an identity to act as. |
| `ask_first_tools` | `string[] \| null` | No | The names of the allowed tools that wait for the conversation owner's approval before they run. |
| `available_tools` | `object[] \| null` | No | Every tool an agent can be allowed to call, with its group and whether it changes data. |
| `web_search_enabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the agent may search the web through its AI provider. |
| `web_search_available` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the agent's model may try to search the web. Its provider can still refuse a search, which the reply then shows. |
| `web_search_blocked_by_tools` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the agent's model can search the web, but not while the agent uses workspace tools. |
| `web_fetch_enabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the agent may open web pages, which Baserow fetches. |
| `available_trigger_types` | `string[] \| null` | No | The trigger types that can be added to the agent on this instance, as service type names. |
| `available_action_types` | `string[] \| null` | No | The service types available as configured agent actions. |
| `max_actions` | `number \| null \| null` | No | How many actions the agent can have on this instance. Null is no limit. |
| `max_queued_trigger_runs` | `number \| null` | No | How many runs of a trigger that waits or runs in parallel can be queued on this instance; later firings are skipped. 0 or less is no limit. |
| `max_parallel_trigger_runs` | `number \| null` | No | How many runs of a trigger that runs in parallel can go at once on this instance; later firings are queued. 0 or less is no limit. |
| `errors` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="run_as full type">

```ts
{
  type?: string | null | null,
  id?: number | null | null,
  name?: string | null | null,
  trashed?: boolean | null,
  status?: string | null
} | null | null
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="available_tools full type">

```ts
{
  name?: string | null,
  group?: string | null,
  changes_data?: boolean | null,
  deactivated?: boolean | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

### listActions

`agents.listActions`

Pins authenticated realtime recovery reads to the primary database. Realtime refresh markers are emitted after a primary-database snapshot. Reading their replacement data from a lagging replica could otherwise restore stale state in the client. Authentication is deliberately completed before….

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.listActions({ agent_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |



**Output:** `object[]`

### listConversations

`agents.listConversations`

Lists the authenticated user's own conversations with the agent and the shared ones its triggers started, pinned first, then most recently active within each group. Each includes its number of tool calls waiting for the user's approval.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.listConversations({ agent_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | The `next_cursor` of the previous page, omitted for the first page. The next page continues after the last conversation of the previous one, even when conversations changed in between. |
| `has_pending_approvals` | `boolean` | No | Only conversations with or without calls waiting for approval. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Maximum number of conversations to return, up to 100. |
| `pinned` | `boolean` | No | Only pinned or unpinned conversations. Omit for both. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `next_cursor` | `string \| null \| null` | No | Pass as `cursor` to get the next page, `null` when no more conversations follow. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="results full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  uuid?: string | null,
  title?: string | null,
  created_on?: string | null,
  updated_on?: string | null,
  run_id?: string | null | null,
  pending_approval_count?: number | null,
  pinned?: boolean | null,
  shared?: boolean | null,
  trigger_id?: number | null | null,
  trigger_type?: any | null | null,
  trigger_name?: any | null | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### listMessages

`agents.listMessages`

Lists the messages of one of the authenticated user's conversations, newest page first, each page in chronological order.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.listMessages({ agent_id: 1, conversation_uuid: '3f0e6a2c-8b1d-4c7e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b6c' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `conversation_uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `page` | `number` | No | — |
| `size` | `number` | No | Number of messages per page, up to 100. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `count` | `number \| null` | No | The total amount of results. |
| `next` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the next page. |
| `previous` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the previous page. |
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### listTriggerTypes

`agents.listTriggerTypes`

Lists the trigger types the agent may use, each with what its form may choose from for the agent's run identity, such as the tables it can read, and the overlap rule a new trigger of it gets. Requires permission to read the agent's configuration.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.listTriggerTypes({ agent_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |



**Output:** `object[]`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  type?: string | null,
  form_choices?: any | null | null,
  default_on_overlap?: string | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.load({ agent_id: 1 });
```

### updateConfiguration

`agents.updateConfiguration`

Updates the provided fields of the agent configuration and returns the result. An incomplete configuration can be saved and finished later.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.updateConfiguration({ agent_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `instructions` | `string` | No | — |
| `provider_type` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `model_identifier` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `reasoning_effort` | `off \| low \| medium \| high \| never \| null \| null` | No | How much the model reasons before it replies. Null uses the model's default. A model that doesn't accept it uses the next higher effort it accepts, or its default. * `off` - off * `low` - low * `medium` - medium * `high` - high |
| `run_as_subject_type` | `auth.User \| never \| null \| null` | No | The type of the identity the agent's tools act as. Provide it with run_as_subject_id; both null means no workspace access and clears the allowed tools. * `auth.User` - auth.User |
| `run_as_subject_id` | `number \| null` | No | The id of the identity the agent's tools act as. |
| `allowed_tools` | `string[]` | No | The names of all the tools the agent may call. Tools left out are turned off. Without a selected Run as identity, all tools stay off. |
| `web_search_enabled` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `web_fetch_enabled` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `ask_first_tools` | `string[]` | No | The names of the allowed tools that wait for the conversation owner's approval. Provide it with allowed_tools. When it's left out, newly allowed tools that change data ask first and the other tools keep their setting. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `readiness` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `instructions` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `provider_type` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `model_identifier` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `reasoning_effort` | `string \| any \| null \| null \| null` | No | How much the model reasons before it replies. Null uses the model's default. * `off` - off * `low` - low * `medium` - medium * `high` - high |
| `applied_reasoning_effort` | `string \| any \| null \| null \| null` | No | The reasoning effort replies use with the selected model: the chosen one, or the next higher one the model accepts. Null means replies use the model's default, because none is chosen, the model doesn't accept one, or the model isn't available. * `off` - off * `low` - low * `medium` - medium * `high` - high |
| `run_as` | `object \| null` | No | The configured identity and its active, trashed or missing status. Null means no workspace access was selected. |
| `allowed_tools` | `string[] \| null` | No | The names of the tools the agent may call while it has an identity to act as. |
| `ask_first_tools` | `string[] \| null` | No | The names of the allowed tools that wait for the conversation owner's approval before they run. |
| `available_tools` | `object[] \| null` | No | Every tool an agent can be allowed to call, with its group and whether it changes data. |
| `web_search_enabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the agent may search the web through its AI provider. |
| `web_search_available` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the agent's model may try to search the web. Its provider can still refuse a search, which the reply then shows. |
| `web_search_blocked_by_tools` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the agent's model can search the web, but not while the agent uses workspace tools. |
| `web_fetch_enabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the agent may open web pages, which Baserow fetches. |
| `available_trigger_types` | `string[] \| null` | No | The trigger types that can be added to the agent on this instance, as service type names. |
| `available_action_types` | `string[] \| null` | No | The service types available as configured agent actions. |
| `max_actions` | `number \| null \| null` | No | How many actions the agent can have on this instance. Null is no limit. |
| `max_queued_trigger_runs` | `number \| null` | No | How many runs of a trigger that waits or runs in parallel can be queued on this instance; later firings are skipped. 0 or less is no limit. |
| `max_parallel_trigger_runs` | `number \| null` | No | How many runs of a trigger that runs in parallel can go at once on this instance; later firings are queued. 0 or less is no limit. |
| `errors` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | — |

### updateConversation

`agents.updateConversation`

Updates the title or pinned state of one of the authenticated user's conversations, without changing its last activity time.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.updateConversation({ agent_id: 1, conversation_uuid: '3f0e6a2c-8b1d-4c7e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b6c' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `conversation_uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `pinned` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `title` | `string` | No | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `uuid` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `created_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `updated_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `run_id` | `string \| null \| null` | No | The run writing a reply in this conversation, or null. |
| `pending_approval_count` | `number \| null` | No | The number of held tool calls in this conversation waiting for a decision. |
| `pinned` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `shared` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether a trigger started this conversation. A shared conversation is read by everyone who may read the agent's conversations, accepts no messages, and its held tool calls are decided by anyone who may send the agent messages. |
| `trigger_id` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The trigger that started this conversation, or null. |
| `trigger_type` | `any \| null \| null` | No | The service type of the trigger that started this conversation, such as periodic, or null. |
| `trigger_name` | `any \| null \| null` | No | The current name of the trigger that started this conversation, blank when it shows its type's default, or null. |

### updateTrigger

`agents.updateTrigger`

Updates the provided fields of the trigger: its name, its switch, its message, its overlap rule, its batch size, its type and the values of its service. Another type replaces the service with a new one of that type. Switching it off cancels its queued replies. Requires permission to update the….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.agents.updateTrigger({ agent_id: 1, trigger_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `agent_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the agent. |
| `trigger_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the trigger. |
| `type` | `string` | No | Another service type for the trigger, one of the configuration's available_trigger_types: its service is replaced by a new one of that type, set from `service`. The trigger keeps its id, name, switch and other settings. |
| `name` | `string` | No | The trigger's name, trimmed. Blank shows a default worded by its type, such as its schedule. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | No | Whether the trigger starts conversations when its event happens. |
| `message` | `Record<string, any>` | No | The formula, resolved against the trigger's payload, whose text opens each conversation the trigger starts. Empty opens it with the payload itself. |
| `on_overlap` | `skip \| wait \| parallel` | No | What a firing does while a reply of the trigger is still going: `skip` starts nothing, `wait` queues its conversation until that reply ends, `parallel` starts it alongside, up to a cap, then queues it. * `skip` - Skip * `wait` - Wait for the previous run * `parallel` - Run in parallel |
| `batch_size` | `number` | No | How many records of a list payload, such as created rows, each conversation receives: a larger event starts one conversation per batch. Payloads that aren't lists ignore it. |
| `service` | `object` | No | The service producing the trigger's events. |

## Applications

### create

`applications.create`

Creates a new application based on the provided type. The newly created application is going to be added to the workspace related to the provided workspace_id parameter. If the authorized user does not belong to the workspace an error will be returned.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.applications.create({ workspace_id: 101, name: 'example', type: 'database' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Creates an application for the workspace related to the provided value. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `type` | `database \| dashboard \| automation \| agent \| builder` | Yes | * `database` - database * `dashboard` - dashboard * `automation` - automation * `agent` - agent * `builder` - builder |
| `init_with_data` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `description` | `string` | No | — |
| `untrusted_content` | `boolean` | No | Blocks custom code and embedded content until explicitly trusted. |
| `favicon_file` | `object \| null` | No | The favicon image file |
| `login_page_id` | `number \| null` | No | The login page for this application. This is related to the visibility settings of builder pages. |
| `breakpoints` | `Record<string, number>` | No | The maximum widths in pixels for the responsive layouts, between 320 and 1920 pixels. Mobile and tablet breakpoints are required. |
| `scripts` | `object[]` | No | Custom CSS/JS scripts for this builder |
| `custom_code` | `object` | No | Custom CSS/JS code for this builder |
| `head_html` | `string` | No | Custom HTML for the document head. |

### delete

`applications.delete`

Deletes an application if the authorized user is in the application's workspace. All the related children are also going to be deleted. For example in case of a database application all the underlying tables, fields, views and rows are going to be deleted.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.applications.delete({ application_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `application_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Deletes the application related to the provided value. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### duplicateAsync

`applications.duplicateAsync`

Duplicate an application if the authorized user is in the application's workspace. All the related children are also going to be duplicated. For example in case of a database application all the underlying tables, fields, views and rows are going to be duplicated.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.applications.duplicateAsync({ application_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `application_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the application to duplicate. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `type` | `any \| null` | No | The type of the job. |
| `progress_percentage` | `number \| null` | No | A percentage indicating how far along the job is. 100 means that it's finished. |
| `state` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates the state of the import job. |
| `human_readable_error` | `string \| null` | No | A human readable error message indicating what went wrong. |
| `error_code` | `string \| null` | No | A machine readable error code indicating why the job failed. |
| `created_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `updated_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `original_application` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `duplicated_application` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### get

`applications.get`

Returns the requested application if the authorized user is in the application's workspace. The properties that belong to the application can differ per type.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.applications.get({ application_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `application_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Returns the application related to the provided value. |



**Output:** `object`

### listAll

### order

`applications.order`

Changes the order of the provided application ids to the matching position that the id has in the list. If the authorized user does not belong to the workspace it will be ignored. The order of the not provided tables will be set to 0.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.applications.order({
	workspace_id: 101,
	application_ids: [1],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the order of the applications in the workspace related to the provided value. |
| `application_ids` | `number[]` | Yes | Application ids in the desired order. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### update

`applications.update`

Updates the existing application related to the provided application_id param if the authorized user is in the application's workspace. It is not possible to change the type, but properties like the name can be changed.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.applications.update({ application_id: 1, name: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `application_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the application related to the provided value. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `description` | `string` | No | — |
| `untrusted_content` | `boolean` | No | Blocks custom code and embedded content until explicitly trusted. |
| `favicon_file` | `object \| null` | No | The favicon image file |
| `login_page_id` | `number \| null` | No | The login page for this application. This is related to the visibility settings of builder pages. |
| `breakpoints` | `Record<string, number>` | No | The maximum widths in pixels for the responsive layouts, between 320 and 1920 pixels. Mobile and tablet breakpoints are required. |
| `scripts` | `object[]` | No | Custom CSS/JS scripts for this builder |
| `custom_code` | `object` | No | Custom CSS/JS code for this builder |
| `head_html` | `string` | No | Custom HTML for the document head. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="favicon_file full type">

```ts
{
  size: number,
  mime_type?: string,
  is_image?: boolean,
  image_width?: number | null,
  image_height?: number | null,
  original_name: string
} | null
```

## Assistant

### cancelMessage

`assistant.cancelMessage`

Cancel an ongoing assistant message generation in the specified chat.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.assistant.cancelMessage({ chat_uuid: '3f0e6a2c-8b1d-4c7e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b6c' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `chat_uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### getOnboardingPromptSuggestions

`assistant.getOnboardingPromptSuggestions`

Suggests databases the user could create during the onboarding, based on the industry and team they provided. The first suggestion is the most relevant one.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.assistant.getOnboardingPromptSuggestions({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `industry` | `string` | No | The industry the user works in. |
| `team` | `string` | No | The team the user is part of. |
| `language` | `string` | No | ISO 639 language code the suggestions must be written in. Falls back to the language of the user's profile. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `suggestions` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

```ts
  name?: string | null,
  prompt?: string | null
}[] | null
```

### sendMessage

`assistant.sendMessage`

Send a message to the specified AI assistant chat and stream back the response. Reconnect through the core chat-run stream endpoint.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.assistant.sendMessage({
	chat_uuid: '3f0e6a2c-8b1d-4c7e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b6c',
	content: 'example',
	ui_context: {
		workspace: { id: 1, name: 'example' },
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `chat_uuid` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `content` | `string` | Yes | The content of the message. |
| `ui_context` | `object` | Yes | The UI context related to what the user was looking at when the message was sent. |
| `tab_id` | `string` | No | This tab's id; only the tab that sent the message receives Kuma's navigation. |

| `filter_to_timestamp` | `string \| null` | No | Optional: The end date to filter the audit log by. |
| `exclude_columns` | `string \| null` | No | Optional: A comma separated list of column names to exclude from the export. Available options are `workspace_name, workspace_id, type, description, timestamp, ip_address, actor_type, actor_user_type, actor_name, actor_id`. The legacy `user_email` and `user_id` names are accepted as aliases for `actor_name` and `actor_id`. |
| `created_on` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the export job was created. |
| `exported_file_name` | `any \| null` | No | The name of the file that was created by the export job. |

### adminList

`auditLog.adminList`

Lists all audit log entries for the given workspace id. This is a enterprise feature.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.auditLog.adminList({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `action_type` | `string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by action type. |
| `actor_id` | `number \| string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by actor id. |
| `actor_type` | `string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by actor type. |
| `from_timestamp` | `string` | No | The ISO timestamp to filter the audit log entries from. |
| `ids` | `string` | No | A comma-separated list of audit log entries IDs to filter by. When provided, only audit log entries with those IDs are returned. |
| `page` | `number` | No | Defines which page should be returned. |
| `size` | `number` | No | Defines how many audit log entries should be returned per page. |
| `sorts` | `string` | No | A comma separated string of attributes to sort by, each attribute must be prefixed with `+` for a descending sort or a `-` for an ascending sort. The accepted attribute names are: `timestamp`. For example `sorts=-timestamp,-field_2` will sort the audit log entries first by descending timestamp and then ascending field_2. A sortparameter with multiple instances of the same sort attribute will respond with the ERROR_INVALID_SORT_ATTRIBUTE error. |
| `to_timestamp` | `string` | No | The ISO timestamp to filter the audit log entries to. |
| `user_id` | `number \| string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by user id. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by workspace id. This filter works only for the admin audit log. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `count` | `number \| null` | No | The total amount of results. |
| `next` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the next page. |
| `previous` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the previous page. |
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="results full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  action_type?: any | null,
  user?: any | null,
  actor?: {
    user_type?: string | null | null,
    id?: number | null | null,
    type?: string | null | null,
    name?: string | null | null
  } | null,
  workspace?: any | null,
  type?: any | null,
  description?: any | null,
  timestamp?: string | null,
  ip_address?: any | null | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### list

`auditLog.list`

Lists all audit log entries for the given workspace id. This is a enterprise feature.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.auditLog.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `action_type` | `string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by action type. |
| `actor_id` | `number \| string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by actor id. |
| `actor_type` | `string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by actor type. |
| `from_timestamp` | `string` | No | The ISO timestamp to filter the audit log entries from. |
| `ids` | `string` | No | A comma-separated list of audit log entries IDs to filter by. When provided, only audit log entries with those IDs are returned. |
| `page` | `number` | No | Defines which page should be returned. |
| `size` | `number` | No | Defines how many audit log entries should be returned per page. |
| `sorts` | `string` | No | A comma separated string of attributes to sort by, each attribute must be prefixed with `+` for a descending sort or a `-` for an ascending sort. The accepted attribute names are: `timestamp`. For example `sorts=-timestamp,-field_2` will sort the audit log entries first by descending timestamp and then ascending field_2. A sortparameter with multiple instances of the same sort attribute will respond with the ERROR_INVALID_SORT_ATTRIBUTE error. |
| `to_timestamp` | `string` | No | The ISO timestamp to filter the audit log entries to. |
| `user_id` | `number \| string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by user id. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| string` | No | Filter the audit log entries by workspace id. This filter works only for the admin audit log. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `count` | `number \| null` | No | The total amount of results. |
| `next` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the next page. |
| `previous` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the previous page. |
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="results full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  action_type?: any | null,
  user?: any | null,
  actor?: {
    user_type?: string | null | null,
    id?: number | null | null,
    type?: string | null | null,
    name?: string | null | null
  } | null,
  workspace?: any | null,
  type?: any | null,
  description?: any | null,
  timestamp?: string | null,
  ip_address?: any | null | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Auth

### configureTwoFactor

`auth.configureTwoFactor`

Configures two-factor authentication for the authenticated user.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.auth.configureTwoFactor({
	backup_codes: ['example'],
	provisioning_qr_code: 'example',
	provisioning_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
	type: 'totp',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | `totp` | Yes | The type of the two factor auth. * `totp` - totp |
| `provisioning_url` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `provisioning_qr_code` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `backup_codes` | `string[]` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `is_enabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `provisioning_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `provisioning_qr_code` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `backup_codes` | `string[] \| null` | No | — |

### providerLoginUrl

`auth.providerLoginUrl`

Return the correct redirect_url to initiate the SSO SAML login. It needs an email address if multiple SAML providers are configured otherwise the only configured SAML provider signup URL will be returned. Public: no sign-in.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.auth.providerLoginUrl({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `email` | `string` | No | The email address of the user that want to sign in using SAML. |
| `language` | `string` | No | An ISO 639 language code (with optional variant) selected by the user. Ex: en-GB. |
| `original` | `string` | No | The url to which the user should be redirected after a successful login. |
| `workspace_invitation_link_slug` | `string` | No | The slug of the workspace invitation link that a new user signs up through. |
| `workspace_invitation_token` | `string` | No | If provided and valid, the user accepts the workspace invitation and will have access to the workspace after login or signing up. |



**Output:** `Record<string, string>`

## Automations

### history.cancelWorkflow

`automations.history.cancelWorkflow`

Requests the cancellation of a running workflow. The run stops before the next node is dispatched; the node currently running is not interrupted. If the run completes before the cancellation takes effect, it resolves as completed. Only the first request is recorded: a later one is refused so….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.automations.history.cancelWorkflow({ workflow_history_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `workflow_history_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the workflow history to cancel. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `started_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `completed_on` | `string \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `message` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | * `success` - Success * `error` - Error * `disabled` - Disabled * `started` - Started * `skipped` - Skipped * `cancelled` - Cancelled * `retried` - Retried * `waiting` - Waiting |
| `is_test_run` | `boolean \| null` | No | True when the workflow is being simulated. |
| `simulate_until_node` | `number \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `cancellation_requested_on` | `string \| null \| null` | No | When the cancellation of this run was requested. |
| `plugin_data` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | No | — |
| `triggered_by` | `object \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="triggered_by full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  type?: any | null,
  user_type?: any | null | null,
  name?: any | null
} | null | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### nodes.delete

`automations.nodes.delete`

Deletes an existing automation node. (DELETE /api/automation/node/&#123;node_id&#125;/)

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.automations.nodes.delete({ node_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `node_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the node to delete. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### nodes.duplicate

`automations.nodes.duplicate`

Duplicate a node of a workflow. (POST /api/automation/node/&#123;node_id&#125;/duplicate/)

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.automations.nodes.duplicate({ node_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `node_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The node that is to be duplicated. |



**Output:** `object`

---

### nodes.list

`automations.nodes.list`

Lists all the nodes of the workflow related to the provided parameter if the user has access to the related automation's workspace. If the workspace is related to a template, then this endpoint will be publicly accessible.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.automations.nodes.list({ workflow_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `workflow_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Returns the nodes related to a specific workflow. |



**Output:** `object[]`

---

### nodes.move

`automations.nodes.move`

Move a node in a workflow to a new position.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.automations.nodes.move({ node_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `node_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The node that is to be moved. |
| `reference_node_id` | `number` | No | The reference node. |
| `position` | `north \| south \| child \| ""` | No | The new position relative to the reference node. * `north` - North * `south` - South * `child` - Child |
| `output` | `string` | No | The new output. |



**Output:** `object`

### nodes.replace

`automations.nodes.replace`

Replace a node in a workflow with one of a new type.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.automations.nodes.replace({ node_id: 1, new_type: 'local_baserow_create_row' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `node_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The node that is to be replaced. |

### nodes.simulateDispatch

`automations.nodes.simulateDispatch`

Simulate a dispatch for a node. (POST /api/automation/node/&#123;node_id&#125;/simulate-dispatch/)

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.automations.nodes.simulateDispatch({ node_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `node_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The node to simulate the dispatch for. |



**Output:** `object`

### nodes.update

`automations.nodes.update`

Updates an existing automation node. (PATCH /api/automation/node/&#123;node_id&#125;/)

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.automations.nodes.update({ node_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `node_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the node to update. |
| `label` | `string` | No | A label to use when displaying this node in a graph. |
| `note` | `string` | No | A Markdown note explaining what this object is for. |
| `on_failure` | `stop \| retry` | No | What happens when this node fails: stop the run, or retry the node first. * `stop` - Stop * `retry` - Retry |
| `max_retries` | `number` | No | How many times the node is retried after its first attempt. Only used when on_failure is retry. |
| `retry_condition` | `Record<string, any>` | No | Formula evaluated against the node's result (the `current_node` data provider). When true the attempt counts as failed; empty means no condition. |
| `service` | `object` | No | The service associated with this automation node. |
