### update

`templates.update`

Updates a user template owned by the user. With visibility public, its latest revision goes to review, and once an instance admin approves it, it's listed, with the name of its author, for everybody on this instance, who can open it. Signed-in users can install it. It's listed right away only….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.templates.update({ slug: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | The slug of the template to update. |
| `visibility` | `public \| private` | No | `public` lists the template, with the name of its author, for everybody on this instance. `private` takes it out of that listing, so that only its owner and anyone with its private link can open it. * `public` - public * `private` - private |
| `public_listing_consent` | `boolean` | No | Must be true with `public`: the author agrees that the template and their name are listed for everybody on this instance. It's recorded in the audit log. |
| `private_link` | `boolean` | No | `true` creates the private link of the template. Anyone with the link can preview the template, also signed out, and install or download it once signed in. `false` turns the link off, so that it stops working. A public template stays public. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `revision_id` | `number \| null` | No | The id of the serialized revision. Sent with an install, so that the template isn't installed if it was updated since. |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | Whether it's an official or a user template. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `slug` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | The description of this revision. |
| `icon` | `string \| null` | No | The icon class name that can be used for displaying purposes. |
| `keywords` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The group containing the applications related to the template. The read endpoints related to that group are publicly accessible for preview purposes. Revisions of the same template that only differ in their details share it. |
| `is_default` | `any \| null` | No | Indicates if the template must be selected by default. The web-frontend automatically selects the first `is_default` template that it can find. |
| `open_application` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The application ID that must be opened when the template is previewed. If null, then the first will automatically be chosen. |
| `author_name` | `any \| null \| null` | No | The first name of the author of a user template. Null for an official template or a deleted author. |
| `is_own` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the authenticated user owns this user template. |
| `updated_on` | `string \| null` | No | When the content shown was last changed: the creation of the revision of a user template, the last update of an official one. |
| `categories` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `state` | `string \| any \| null \| null \| null` | No | The state of the template as shown to its owner, and to instance admins on the template page. Null for anyone else. |
| `reason` | `any \| null` | No | Why the template was rejected or blocked, if given. Only shown to its owner, and to instance admins on the template page. |
| `can_make_public` | `boolean \| null \| null` | No | Whether making the template public lists it or sends it to review: it's not blocked, in review, or listed as it is. Only shown to its owner, null on listed rows. |
| `make_public_needs_review` | `boolean \| null \| null` | No | Whether making the template public sends it to the review of an instance admin, because approval is required or an admin rejected it since it was last approved. Only shown to its owner, null on listed rows. |
| `update_needs_review` | `boolean \| null \| null` | No | Whether an update of the template sends it to the review of an instance admin: when it's listed and approval is required or an admin rejected it since it was last approved, or when it's in review already. Only shown to its owner. |
| `listed` | `boolean \| null \| null` | No | Whether a revision of the template is listed for everybody, also while a later one is in review or rejected. Only shown to its owner, and to instance admins on the template page. |
| `source_workspace_id` | `number \| null` | No | The workspace the applications of the latest revision were copied from, if known. Only shown to its owner. |
| `source_application_ids` | `number[] \| null \| null` | No | The applications the latest revision was copied from. Only shown to its owner. |
| `install_count` | `number \| null \| null` | No | How many times the template was installed. Only shown to its owner. |
| `private_link_token` | `any \| null \| null` | No | The token of the private link, null without one. Only shown to its owner. |
| `created_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |

## Trash

### emptyContents

`trash.emptyContents`

Empties the specified workspace and/or application of trash, including the workspace and application themselves if they are trashed also. Deletes the trashed items for good.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.trash.emptyContents({ workspace_id: 101 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `application_id` | `number \| string` | No | Optionally filters down the trash to delete to only items for this application in the workspace. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The workspace whose trash contents to empty, including the workspace itself if it is also trashed. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### redo

`user.redo`

Redoes the latest redoable action performed by the user making the request. a ClientSessionId header must be provided and only actions which were performed the same user with the same ClientSessionId value set on the api request that performed the action will be redone.Additionally the….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.user.redo({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | The particular client session to redo actions for. The actions must have been performed with this same header set with the same value for them to be redoable by this endpoint. |
| `scopes` | `object` | No | A JSON object with keys and values representing the various action scopes to include when undoing or redoing. Every action in Baserow will be associated with a action scope, when undoing/redoing only actions which match any of the provided scope key:value pairs will included when this endpoint picks the next action to undo/redo. If no scopes are provided then all actions performed in the client session will be included when undoing/redoing. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="scopes full type">

```ts

  view?: number | null,
  page?: number | null,
  shared_page?: number | null,
  workflow?: number | null,
  teams_in_workspace?: number | null
}
```
</Accordion>

### signUp

`user.signUp`

Creates a new user based on the provided values. If desired an authentication JWT can be generated right away. After creating an account the initial workspace containing a database is created. Public: no sign-in.

**Risk:** `write`


| `password` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `language` | `string` | No | An ISO 639 language code (with optional variant) selected by the user. Ex: en-GB. |
| `authenticate` | `boolean` | No | Indicates whether an authentication JWT should be generated and be included in the response. |
| `workspace_invitation_token` | `string` | No | If provided and valid, the user accepts the workspace invitation and will have access to the workspace after signing up. |

| `workspace_invitation_link_token` | `string` | No | The access token of a password protected invitation link, handed out by its auth endpoint. Required with `workspace_invitation_link_slug` when the link has a password. |
| `template_id` | `number` | No | The id of the template that must be installed after creating the account. This only works if the `workspace_invitation_token` and `workspace_invitation_link_slug` params are not provided. |
| `captcha_token` | `string` | No | The captcha response token, required when captcha is enabled. |

Every action in Baserow will be associated with a action scope, when undoing/redoing only actions which match any of the provided scope key:value pairs will included when this endpoint picks the next action to undo/redo. If no scopes are provided then all actions performed in the client session will be included when undoing/redoing. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="scopes full type">

```ts
{
  root?: boolean | null,
  workspace?: number | null,
  all_workspaces?: boolean | null,
  application?: number | null,
  table?: number | null,
  view?: number | null,
  page?: number | null,
  shared_page?: number | null,
  workflow?: number | null,
  teams_in_workspace?: number | null
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `actions` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `result_code` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates the result of the undo/redo operation. Will be 'SUCCESS' on success, 'NOTHING_TO_DO' when there is no action to undo/redo and 'SKIPPED_DUE_TO_ERROR' when the undo/redo failed due to a conflict or error and was skipped over. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="actions full type">

```ts
{
  action_type?: string | null | null,
  action_scope?: string | null | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Views

### calendar.getIcalFeed

`views.calendar.getIcalFeed`

Returns ICal feed for a specific Calendar view identified by ical_slug value. Calendar View resource contains full url in .ical_feed_url field.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.calendar.getIcalFeed({ ical_slug: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `ical_slug` | `string` | Yes | ICal feed unique slug. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### calendar.rotateIcalFeedSlug

`views.calendar.rotateIcalFeedSlug`

Rotates the unique slug of the calendar view's ical feed by replacing it with a new value. This would mean that the publicly shared URL of the view will change. Anyone with the old URL won't be able to access the view anymore.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.calendar.rotateIcalFeedSlug({ view_id: 2001 });
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Rotates the ical feed slug of the calendar view related to the provided id. |

### copyConfiguration

`views.copyConfiguration`

Copies the requested configuration categories, the filters or sorts for example, of another view in the same table into this view, replacing this view's existing configuration of those categories. Only categories supported by both view types can be copied. The whole copy can be reverted with a….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.copyConfiguration({
	view_id: 2001,
	categories: ['field_visibility'],
	source_view_id: 1,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The view to copy the configuration into. |
| `source_view_id` | `number` | Yes | The id of the view in the same table to copy the configuration from. |
| `categories` | `(field_visibility \| field_order \| field_widths \| view_settings \| filters \| sorts \| group_bys \| decorations \| default_row_values)[]` | Yes | The configuration categories that must be copied. Only categories supported by both the source and destination view type are accepted. |



**Output:** `object`

### create

`views.create`

Creates a new view for the table related to the provided table_id parameter. Depending on the type, different properties can optionally be set.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.create({ table_id: 1001, name: 'example', type: 'grid' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `include` | `string` | No | A comma separated list of extra attributes to include on each view in the response. The supported attributes are `filters`, `sortings` and `decorations`. For example `include=filters,sortings` will add the attributes `filters` and `sortings` to every returned view, containing a list of the views filters and sortings respectively. |
| `table_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Creates a view for the table related to the provided value. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `type` | `grid \| gallery \| form \| kanban \| calendar \| timeline` | Yes | * `grid` - grid * `gallery` - gallery * `form` - form * `kanban` - kanban * `calendar` - calendar * `timeline` - timeline |
| `ownership_type` | `collaborative \| personal \| restricted` | No | * `collaborative` - collaborative * `personal` - personal * `restricted` - restricted |
| `filter_type` | `AND \| OR` | No | Indicates whether all the rows should apply to all filters (AND) or to any filter (OR). * `AND` - And * `OR` - Or |
| `filters_disabled` | `boolean` | No | Allows users to see results unfiltered while still keeping the filters saved for the view. |
| `row_identifier_type` | `id \| count` | No | * `id` - Id * `count` - Count |
| `row_height_size` | `small \| medium \| large` | No | * `small` - Small * `medium` - Medium * `large` - Large |
| `frozen_column_count` | `number` | No | Number of frozen columns including the primary field. |
| `group_by_layout` | `section \| column` | No | How grouped rows are presented: sections with a header above each group, or one column per group-by level beside the rows. * `section` - Section * `column` - Column |
| `public` | `boolean` | No | Indicates whether the view is publicly accessible to visitors. |
| `card_cover_image_field` | `number \| null` | No | References a file field of which the first image must be shown as card cover image. |
| `title` | `string` | No | The title that is displayed at the beginning of the form. |
| `description` | `string` | No | The description that is displayed at the beginning of the form. |
| `mode` | `form \| survey` | No | Configurable mode of the form. * `form` - form * `survey` - survey |
| `cover_image` | `object \| null` | No | The cover image that must be displayed at the top of the form. |
| `logo_image` | `object \| null` | No | The logo image that must be displayed at the top of the form. |
| `submit_text` | `string` | No | The text displayed on the submit button. |
| `submit_action` | `MESSAGE \| REDIRECT` | No | The action that must be performed after the visitor has filled out the form. * `MESSAGE` - Message * `REDIRECT` - Redirect |
| `submit_action_message` | `string` | No | If the `submit_action` is MESSAGE, then this message will be shown to the visitor after submitting the form. |
| `submit_action_redirect_url` | `string \| string` | No | If the `submit_action` is REDIRECT,then the visitors will be redirected to the this URL after submitting the form. |
| `single_select_field` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `date_field` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `ical_public` | `boolean \| null` | No | A flag to show if ical feed is exposed. Set this field to True when modifying this resource to enable ICal feed url. |
| `start_date_field` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `end_date_field` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `timescale` | `day \| week \| month \| year` | No | The timescale that the timeline should be displayed in. * `day` - Day * `week` - Week * `month` - Month * `year` - Year |

### decorations.create

`views.decorations.create`

Creates a new decoration for the view related to the provided view_id parameter if the authorized user has access to the related database's workspace.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.decorations.create({ view_id: 2001, type: 'left_border_color' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Creates a decoration for the view related to the given value. |
| `type` | `left_border_color \| background_color` | Yes | The decorator type. This is then interpreted by the frontend to display the decoration. * `left_border_color` - left_border_color * `background_color` - background_color |
| `value_provider_type` | `single_select_color \| conditional_color \| ""` | No | The value provider type that gives the value to the decorator. * `` - * `single_select_color` - single_select_color * `conditional_color` - conditional_color |
| `value_provider_conf` | `object` | No | — |
| `order` | `number` | No | The position of the decorator has within the view, lowest first. If there is another decorator with the same order value then the decorator with the lowest id must be shown first. |

### decorations.delete

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.decorations.delete({ view_decoration_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_decoration_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Deletes the decoration related to the provided value. |

### decorations.update

`views.decorations.update`

Updates the existing decoration if the authorized user has access to the related database's workspace.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.decorations.update({ view_decoration_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_decoration_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the view decoration related to the provided value. |
| `type` | `left_border_color \| background_color` | No | The decorator type. This is then interpreted by the frontend to display the decoration. * `left_border_color` - left_border_color * `background_color` - background_color |
| `value_provider_type` | `single_select_color \| conditional_color \| ""` | No | The value provider type that gives the value to the decorator. * `` - * `single_select_color` - single_select_color * `conditional_color` - conditional_color |
| `value_provider_conf` | `object` | No | — |
| `order` | `number` | No | The position of the decorator has within the view, lowest first. If there is another decorator with the same order value then the decorator with the lowest id must be shown first. |

### delete

`views.delete`

Deletes the existing view. Note that all the related settings of the view are going to be deleted also. The data stays intact after deleting the view because this is related to the table and not the view.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.delete({ view_id: 2001 });
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

### duplicate

`views.duplicate`

Duplicates an existing view if the user has access to it. When a view is duplicated everything is copied except: - The name is appended with the copy number. Ex: ViewName-&gt;ViewName(2) and View(2)-&gt;View(3) - If the original view is publicly shared, the new view will not be shared anymore.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.duplicate({ view_id: 2001 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

### export.getPublicJob

`views.export.getPublicJob`

Returns information such as export progress and state or the url of the exported file for the specified export job, only if the requesting user has access. This is a premium feature.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.export.getPublicJob({ job_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `job_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The signed job id to lookup information about. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

### export.startPublic

`views.export.startPublic`

Creates and starts a new export job for a publicly shared view given some exporter options. Returns an error if the view doesn't support exporting. This is a premium feature.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.export.startPublic({ slug: 'example', exporter_type: 'csv' });
```

| `filters` | `object \| null` | No | A JSON serialized string containing the filter tree to apply to this view. The filter tree is a nested structure containing the filters that need to be applied. ### filters.updateGroup

`views.filters.updateGroup`

Updates the existing filter group with the given view_filter_group_id.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.filters.updateGroup({ view_filter_group_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_filter_group_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The ID of the view filter group to update. |
| `filter_type` | `AND \| OR` | No | Indicates whether all the rows should apply to all filters (AND) or to any filter (OR) in the group to be shown. * `AND` - And * `OR` - Or |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `filter_type` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates whether all the rows should apply to all filters (AND) or to any filter (OR) in the group to be shown. * `AND` - And * `OR` - Or |
| `view` | `number \| null` | No | The view to which the filter group applies to. Each view can have its own filter groups. |
| `parent_group` | `number \| null \| null` | No | — |

### form.getEditRow

`views.form.getEditRow`

Returns the current field values of the row identified by the edit token. Only fields visible in the form view are returned. The token must be a valid signed token generated by a form_view_edit_row field.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.form.getEditRow({ row_token: 'example', slug: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `row_token` | `string` | Yes | The signed edit token that identifies the row to edit. |
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | The slug of the form view. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the row in the table. |
| `order` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates the position of the row, lowest first and highest last. |
| `metadata` | `object \| null` | No | Additional metadata for the row, if `include=metadata' is provided as query parameter. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="metadata full type">

```ts
{
  row_comment_count?: number | null,
  row_comments_notification_mode?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### form.getMeta

`views.form.getMeta`

Returns the metadata related to the form view if the form is publicly shared or if the user has access to the related workspace. This data can be used to construct a form with the right fields.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.form.getMeta({ slug: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

**Output**

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | The title that is displayed at the beginning of the form. |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | The description that is displayed at the beginning of the form. |
| `mode` | `string \| null` | No | Configurable mode of the form. * `form` - form * `survey` - survey |
| `cover_image` | `object \| null` | No | The user file cover image that is displayed at the top of the form. |
| `logo_image` | `object \| null` | No | The user file logo image that is displayed at the top of the form. |
| `submit_text` | `string \| null` | No | The text displayed on the submit button. |
| `fields` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `show_logo` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `allow_public_export` | `boolean \| null` | No | Indicates whether it's allowed to export a publicly shared view. |

### form.submit

`views.form.submit`

Submits the form if the form is publicly shared or if the user has access to the related workspace. The provided data will be validated based on the fields that are in the form and the rules per field. If valid, a new row will be created in the table.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.form.submit({ slug: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | The slug related to the form. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `submit_action` | `string \| null` | No | The action that must be performed after the visitor has filled out the form. * `MESSAGE` - Message * `REDIRECT` - Redirect |
| `submit_action_message` | `string \| null` | No | If the `submit_action` is MESSAGE, then this message will be shown to the visitor after submitting the form. |
| `submit_action_redirect_url` | `string \| string \| null` | No | If the `submit_action` is REDIRECT,then the visitors will be redirected to the this URL after submitting the form. |
| `row_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |

| `slug` | `string` | Yes | The slug of the form view. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `submit_action` | `string \| null` | No | The action that must be performed after the visitor has filled out the form. * `MESSAGE` - Message * `REDIRECT` - Redirect |
| `submit_action_message` | `string \| null` | No | If the `submit_action` is MESSAGE, then this message will be shown to the visitor after submitting the form. |
| `submit_action_redirect_url` | `string \| string \| null` | No | If the `submit_action` is REDIRECT,then the visitors will be redirected to the this URL after submitting the form. |
| `row_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |

### form.uploadFile

`views.form.uploadFile`

Uploads a file anonymously to Baserow by uploading the file contents directly. A file multipart is expected containing the file contents.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.form.uploadFile({
	slug: 'example',
	file: { base64: 'SGVsbG8gZnJvbSBDb3JzYWly', filename: 'notes.txt', contentType: 'text/plain' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | Submits files only if the view with the provided slughas a public file field. |
| `file` | `string \| object \| custom` | Yes | The file to upload. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="file full type">

```ts
string | {
  url: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | {
  base64: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | custom
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `size` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `mime_type` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `is_image` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `image_width` | `number \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `image_height` | `number \| null \| null` | No | — |
| `uploaded_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `thumbnails` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | No | — |
| `name` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `original_name` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### get

`views.get`

Returns the existing view. Depending on the type different properties could be returned.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.get({ view_id: 2001 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `include` | `string` | No | A comma separated list of extra attributes to include on the returned view. The supported attributes are `filters`, `sortings` and `decorations`. For example `include=filters,sortings` will add the attributes `filters` and `sortings` to every returned view, containing a list of the views filters and sortings respectively. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Returns the view related to the provided value. |

### grid.filterRows

`views.grid.filterRows`

Lists only the rows and fields that match the request. Only the rows with the ids that are in the row_ids list are going to be returned. Same goes for the fields, only the fields with the ids in the field_ids are going to be returned. This endpoint could be used to refresh data after changes….

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.grid.filterRows({
	view_id: 2001,
	row_ids: [1],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Returns only rows that belong to the related view's table. |
| `field_ids` | `number[]` | No | Only the fields related to the provided ids are added to the response. If None are provided all fields will be returned. |
| `row_ids` | `number[]` | Yes | Only rows related to the provided ids are added to the response. |



**Output:** `object[]`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  order?: string | null,
  metadata?: {
    row_comment_count?: number | null,
    row_comments_notification_mode?: string | null
  } | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### grid.getFieldAggregation

`views.grid.getFieldAggregation`

Computes the aggregation of all the values for a specified field from the selected grid view. You must select the aggregation type by setting the type GET parameter. If filters are configured for the selected view, the aggregation is calculated only on filtered rows. You need to have read….

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.grid.getFieldAggregation({ field_id: 3001, view_id: 2001 });
```

| `type` | `string` | No | The aggregation type you want. Available aggregation types: count, empty_count, not_empty_count, unique_count, min, max, sum, average, median, decile, variance, std_dev, distribution |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Select the view you want the aggregation for. |



**Output**

| `value` | `number \| string \| any[] \| object \| null` | No | — |
| `total` | `number \| null` | No | The total value count. Only returned if `include=total` is specified as GET parameter. |

### groupBys.create

`views.groupBys.create`

Creates a new group by for the view related to the provided view_id parameter if the authorized user has access to the related database's workspace.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.groupBys.create({ view_id: 2001, field: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Creates a group by for the view related to the provided value. |
| `field` | `number` | Yes | The field that must be grouped by. |
| `order` | `ASC \| DESC` | No | Indicates the sort order direction. ASC (Ascending) is from A to Z and DESC (Descending) is from Z to A. * `ASC` - Ascending * `DESC` - Descending |
| `width` | `number` | No | The pixel width of the group by in the related view. |
| `type` | `string` | No | Indicates the sort type. Will automatically fall back to `default` if incompatible with field type. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `view` | `number \| null` | No | The view to which the group by applies. Each view can have his own group bys. |
| `field` | `number \| null` | No | The field that must be grouped by. |
| `order` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates the sort order direction. ASC (Ascending) is from A to Z and DESC (Descending) is from Z to A. * `ASC` - Ascending * `DESC` - Descending |
| `width` | `number \| null` | No | The pixel width of the group by in the related view. |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates the sort type. Will automatically fall back to `default` if incompatible with field type. |
| `priority` | `number \| null` | No | Position of this group by in the ordering chain. The group by with the lowest priority is applied first. |

### groupBys.prioritize

`views.groupBys.prioritize`

Updates the priority of the provided view group by ids to the matching position that the id has in the list. The group by with the lowest position in the list is applied first when ordering rows.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.groupBys.prioritize({
	view_id: 2001,
	view_group_by_ids: [1],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the priority of the group bys in the view related to the provided value. |
| `view_group_by_ids` | `number[]` | Yes | View group by ids in the desired priority order. The group by with the lowest position in the list is applied first. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### kanban.publicListRows

`views.kanban.publicListRows`

Responds with serialized rows grouped by the view's single select field options related to the slug if the kanban view is publicly shared. Additional query parameters can be provided to control the limit and offset per select option. This is a premium feature.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.kanban.publicListRows({ slug: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `filter__{field}__{filter}` | `string` | No | The rows can optionally be filtered by the same view filters available for the views. Multiple filters can be provided if they follow the same format. The field and filter variable indicate how to filter and the value indicates where to filter on. For example if you provide the following GET parameter `filter__field_1__equal=test` then only rows where the value of field_1 is equal to test are going to be returned. The following filters are available: equal, not_equal, filename_contains, files_lower_than, has_file_type, contains, contains_not, contains_word, doesnt_contain_word, starts_with, length_is_lower_than, higher_than, higher_than_or_equal, lower_than, lower_than_or_equal, is_even_and_whole, date_equal, date_before, date_before_or_equal, date_after_days_ago, date_after, date_after_or_equal, date_not_equal, date_equals_today, date_before_today, date_after_today, date_within_days, date_within_weeks, date_within_months, date_equals_days_ago, date_equals_months_ago, date_equals_years_ago, date_equals_week, date_equals_month, date_equals_day_of_month, date_equals_year, date_is, date_is_not, date_is_before, date_is_on_or_before, date_is_after, date_is_on_or_after, date_is_within, single_select_equal, single_select_not_equal, single_select_is_any_of, single_select_is_none_of, link_row_has, link_row_has_not, link_row_contains, link_row_not_contains, boolean, empty, not_empty, multiple_select_has, multiple_select_has_not, multiple_collaborators_has, multiple_collaborators_has_not, user_is, user_is_not, has_value_equal, has_not_value_equal, has_value_contains, has_not_value_contains, has_value_contains_word, has_not_value_contains_word, has_value_length_is_lower_than, has_all_values_equal, has_empty_value, has_not_empty_value, has_any_select_option_equal, has_none_select_option_equal, has_value_lower, has_value_lower_or_equal, has_value_higher, has_value_higher_or_equal, has_not_value_higher_or_equal, has_not_value_higher, has_not_value_lower_or_equal, has_not_value_lower, has_date_equal, has_not_date_equal, has_date_before, has_not_date_before, has_date_on_or_before, has_not_date_on_or_before, has_date_on_or_after, has_not_date_on_or_after, has_date_after, has_not_date_after, has_date_within, has_not_date_within. **Please note that if the `filters` parameter is provided, this parameter will be ignored.** |
| `filter_type` | `string` | No | `AND`: Indicates that the rows must match all the provided filters. `OR`: Indicates that the rows only have to match one of the filters. This works only if two or more filters are provided. **Please note that if the `filters` parameter is provided, this parameter will be ignored.** |

### list

`views.list`

Lists all views of the table related to the provided table_id. If the workspace is related to a template, then this endpoint will be publicly accessible. A table can have multiple views. Each view can display the data in a different way. For example the grid view shows the in a spreadsheet like….

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.list({ table_id: 1001 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `include` | `string` | No | A comma separated list of extra attributes to include on each view in the response. The supported attributes are `filters`, `sortings`, `decorations`, `group_bys` and `default_row_values`. For example `include=filters,sortings` will add the attributes `filters` and `sortings` to every returned view, containing a list of the views filters and sortings respectively. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | The maximum amount of views that must be returned. This endpoint doesn't support pagination, but if you for example just need to fetch the first view, you can do that by setting a limit. There isn't a limit by default. |
| `table_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Returns only views of the table related to the provided value. |
| `type` | `string` | No | Optionally filter on the view type. If provided, only views of that type will be returned. |



**Output:** `object[]`

### order

`views.order`

Changes the order of the provided view ids to the matching position that the id has in the list. The order of the not provided views will be set to 0.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.order({
	table_id: 1001,
	view_ids: [2001],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `table_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the order of the views in the table related to the provided value. |
| `view_ids` | `number[]` | Yes | View ids in the desired order. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### publicLinkRowFieldLookup

`views.publicLinkRowFieldLookup`

If the view is publicly shared or if an authenticated user has access to the related workspace, then this endpoint can be used to do a value lookup of the link row fields that are included in the view. Normally it is not possible for a not authenticated visitor to fetch the rows of a table. This….

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.publicLinkRowFieldLookup({ field_id: 3001, slug: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `field_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The field id of the link row field. |
| `search` | `string` | No | If provided only rows with data that matches the search query are going to be returned. |
| `search_mode` | `string` | No | If provided, allows API consumers to determine what kind of search experience they wish to have. If the default `SearchMode.FT_WITH_COUNT` is used, then Postgres full-text search is used. If `SearchMode.COMPAT` is provided then the search term will be exactly searched for including whitespace on each cell. This is the Baserow legacy search behaviour. |
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | The slug related to the view. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `count` | `number \| null` | No | The total amount of results. |
| `next` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the next page. |
| `previous` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the previous page. |
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="results full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  value?: string | null,
  order?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### publicTokenAuth

`views.publicTokenAuth`

Returns a valid never-expiring JWT token for this public shared view if the password provided matches with the one saved by the view's owner.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.publicTokenAuth({ slug: 'example', password: 'example-password' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | The slug of the grid view to get public information about. |
| `password` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `access_token` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### rotateSlug

`views.rotateSlug`

Rotates the unique slug of the view by replacing it with a new value. This would mean that the publicly shared URL of the view will change. Anyone with the old URL won't be able to access the viewanymore. Only view types which are sharable can have their slugs rotated.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.rotateSlug({ view_id: 2001 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Rotates the slug of the view related to the provided value. |



**Output:** `object`

### sortings.create

`views.sortings.create`

Creates a new sort for the view related to the provided view_id parameter if the authorized user has access to the related database's workspace. When the rows of a view are requested, for example via the list_database_table_grid_view_rows endpoint, they will be returned in the respected order….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.sortings.create({ view_id: 2001, field: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Creates a sort for the view related to the provided value. |
| `field` | `number` | Yes | The field that must be sorted on. |
| `order` | `ASC \| DESC` | No | Indicates the sort order direction. ASC (Ascending) is from A to Z and DESC (Descending) is from Z to A. * `ASC` - Ascending * `DESC` - Descending |
| `type` | `string` | No | Indicates the sort type. Will automatically fall back to `default` if incompatible with field type. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `view` | `number \| null` | No | The view to which the sort applies. Each view can have his own sortings. |
| `field` | `number \| null` | No | The field that must be sorted on. |
| `order` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates the sort order direction. ASC (Ascending) is from A to Z and DESC (Descending) is from Z to A. * `ASC` - Ascending * `DESC` - Descending |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | Indicates the sort type. Will automatically fall back to `default` if incompatible with field type. |
| `priority` | `number \| null` | No | Position of this sorting in the ordering chain. The sorting with the lowest priority is applied first. |

### sortings.prioritize

`views.sortings.prioritize`

Updates the priority of the sorts to match the order of the given IDs. Sorts earlier in the list are applied first.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.sortings.prioritize({
	view_id: 2001,
	view_sort_ids: [1],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the priority of the sortings in the view related to the provided value. |
| `view_sort_ids` | `number[]` | Yes | View sort ids in the desired priority order. The sort with the lowest position in the list is applied first. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### timeline.listRows

`views.timeline.listRows`

Lists the requested rows of the view's table related to the provided view_id if the authorized user has access to the database's workspace. The response is paginated either by a limit/offset or page/size style. The style depends on the provided GET parameters. The properties of the returned rows….

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.timeline.listRows({ view_id: 2001 });
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `count` | `boolean` | No | If provided only the count will be returned. |
| `exclude_count` | `boolean` | No | If provided, the count, previous, and next properties will be excluded from the response. This is useful for large datasets where counting the total number of results is slow. |
| `exclude_fields` | `string` | No | All the fields are included in the response by default. You can select a subset of fields by providing the exclude_fields query parameter. If you for example provide the following GET parameter `exclude_fields=field_1,field_2` then the fields with id `1` and id `2` are going to be excluded from the selection and response. |
| `filter__{field}__{filter}` | `string` | No | The rows can optionally be filtered by the same view filters available for the views. Multiple filters can be provided if they follow the same format. The field and filter variable indicate how to filter and the value indicates where to filter on. | `previous` | `string \| null \| null` | No | URL to the previous page. |
| `results` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### update

`views.update`

Updates the existing view. The type cannot be changed. It depends on the existing type which properties can be changed.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.update({ view_id: 2001 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `include` | `string` | No | A comma separated list of extra attributes to include on the returned view. The supported attributes are `filters`, `sortings` and `decorations`. For example `include=filters,sortings` will add the attributes `filters` and `sortings` to every returned view, containing a list of the views filters and sortings respectively. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the view related to the provided value. |
| `name` | `string` | No | — |
| `filter_type` | `AND \| OR` | No | Indicates whether all the rows should apply to all filters (AND) or to any filter (OR). * `AND` - And * `OR` - Or |
| `filters_disabled` | `boolean` | No | Allows users to see results unfiltered while still keeping the filters saved for the view. |
| `public_view_password` | `string \| string` | No | The new password or an empty string to remove any previous password from the view and make it publicly accessible again. |
| `ownership_type` | `string` | No | Indicates how the access to the view is determined. By default, views are collaborative and shared for all users that have access to the table. |
| `row_identifier_type` | `id \| count` | No | * `id` - Id * `count` - Count |
| `row_height_size` | `small \| medium \| large` | No | * `small` - Small * `medium` - Medium * `large` - Large |
| `frozen_column_count` | `number` | No | Number of frozen columns including the primary field. |
| `group_by_layout` | `section \| column` | No | How grouped rows are presented: sections with a header above each group, or one column per group-by level beside the rows. * `section` - Section * `column` - Column |
| `public` | `boolean` | No | Indicates whether the view is publicly accessible to visitors. |
| `card_cover_image_field` | `number \| null` | No | References a file field of which the first image must be shown as card cover image. |
| `title` | `string` | No | The title that is displayed at the beginning of the form. |
| `description` | `string` | No | The description that is displayed at the beginning of the form. |
| `mode` | `form \| survey` | No | Configurable mode of the form. * `form` - form * `survey` - survey |
| `cover_image` | `object \| null` | No | The cover image that must be displayed at the top of the form. |
| `logo_image` | `object \| null` | No | The logo image that must be displayed at the top of the form. |
| `submit_text` | `string` | No | The text displayed on the submit button. |
| `submit_action` | `MESSAGE \| REDIRECT` | No | The action that must be performed after the visitor has filled out the form. * `MESSAGE` - Message * `REDIRECT` - Redirect |
| `submit_action_message` | `string` | No | If the `submit_action` is MESSAGE, then this message will be shown to the visitor after submitting the form. |
| `submit_action_redirect_url` | `string \| string` | No | If the `submit_action` is REDIRECT,then the visitors will be redirected to the this URL after submitting the form. |
| `single_select_field` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `date_field` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `ical_public` | `boolean \| null` | No | A flag to show if ical feed is exposed. Set this field to True when modifying this resource to enable ICal feed url. |
| `start_date_field` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `end_date_field` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `timescale` | `day \| week \| month \| year` | No | The timescale that the timeline should be displayed in. * `day` - Day * `week` - Week * `month` - Month * `year` - Year |

### updateDefaultValues

`views.updateDefaultValues`

Updates the default row values for the specified view. Accepts a list of default value objects, each specifying the field, whether the default is enabled, an optional raw value, and an optional function name (e.g. 'now') for dynamic defaults.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.updateDefaultValues({
	view_id: 2001,
	defaults: [{ field: 1, field_type: 'example', id: 1 }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the default row values for the view with the given id. |
| `defaults` | `object[]` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="defaults full type">

```ts
{
  field: number,
  enabled?: boolean,
  value?: any | null,
  function?: string | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output:** `object[]`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  id?: number | null,
  field?: number | null,
  enabled?: boolean | null,
  value?: any | null | null,
  field_type?: any | null | null,
  function?: string | null | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### updateFieldOptions

`views.updateFieldOptions`

Updates the field options of a view. The field options differ per field type This could for example be used to update the field width of a grid view if the user changes it.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.views.updateFieldOptions({
	view_id: 2001,
	field_options: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `view_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Updates the field options related to the provided value. |
| `field_options` | `object` | Yes | — |

## Webhooks

### create

`webhooks.create`

Creates a new webhook for the table related to the provided table_id parameter if the authorized user has access to the related database workspace.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.webhooks.create({ table_id: 1001, name: 'example', url: 'https://example.com/article' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `table_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Creates a webhook for the table related to the provided value. |
| `url` | `string` | Yes | The URL that must be called when the webhook is triggered. |
| `include_all_events` | `boolean` | No | Indicates whether this webhook should listen to all events. |
| `events` | `string[] \| object` | No | The events the webhook is called for. |
| `event_config` | `object[]` | No | A list containing the addition event options. |
| `request_method` | `POST \| GET \| PUT \| PATCH \| DELETE` | No | The request method that be used when the event occurs. * `POST` - Post * `GET` - Get * `PUT` - Put * `PATCH` - Patch * `DELETE` - Delete |
| `headers` | `Record<string, any>` | No | The additional headers as an object where the key is the name and the value the value. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | An internal name of the webhook. |
| `use_user_field_names` | `boolean` | No | Indicates whether the field names must be used as payload key instead of the id. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="events full type">

```ts
string[] | {
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="event_config full type">

```ts
{
  event_type: rows.created | rows.updated | rows.deleted | field.created | field.updated | field.deleted | view.created | view.updated | view.deleted | view.rows_entered,
  fields?: number[],
  views?: number[]
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `events` | `string[] \| object \| null` | No | The events the webhook is called for. |
| `event_config` | `object[] \| null` | No | A list containing the addition event options. |
| `headers` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | No | The additional headers as an object where the key is the name and the value the value. |
| `calls` | `object[] \| null` | No | All the calls that this webhook made. |
| `created_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `updated_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `use_user_field_names` | `boolean \| null` | No | Indicates whether the field names must be used as payload key instead of the id. |

### delete

`webhooks.delete`

Deletes the existing webhook if the authorized user has access to the related database's workspace.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.webhooks.delete({ webhook_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

### testCall

`webhooks.testCall`

This endpoint triggers a test call based on the provided data if the user has access to the workspace related to the table. The test call will be made immediately and a copy of the request, response and status will be included in the response.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts

```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `table_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the table that must be tested. |
| `url` | `string` | Yes | The URL that must be called when the webhook is triggered. |
| `event_type` | `rows.created \| rows.updated \| rows.deleted \| field.created \| field.updated \| field.deleted \| view.created \| view.updated \| view.deleted \| view.rows_entered` | Yes | The event type that must be used for the test call. * `rows.created` - rows.created * `rows.updated` - rows.updated * `rows.deleted` - rows.deleted * `field.created` - field.created * `field.updated` - field.updated * `field.deleted` - field.deleted * `view.created` - view.created * `view.updated` - view.updated * `view.deleted` - view.deleted * `view.rows_entered` - view.rows_entered |
| `request_method` | `POST \| GET \| PUT \| PATCH \| DELETE` | No | The request method that be used when the event occurs. * `POST` - Post * `GET` - Get * `PUT` - Put * `PATCH` - Patch * `DELETE` - Delete |
| `headers` | `Record<string, any>` | No | The additional headers as an object where the key is the name and the value the value. |
| `use_user_field_names` | `boolean` | No | Indicates whether the field names must be used as payload key instead of the id. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `request` | `any \| null` | No | A text copy of the request headers and body. |
| `response` | `any \| null` | No | A text copy of the response headers and body. |
| `status_code` | `number \| null` | No | The HTTP response status code. |
| `is_unreachable` | `boolean \| null` | No | Indicates whether the provided URL could be reached. |

## Workspaces

### create

`workspaces.create`

Creates a new workspace where only the authorized user has access to. No initial data like database applications are added, they have to be created via other endpoints.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.workspaces.create({ name: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | Workspace id. |
| `name` | `any \| null` | No | Workspace name. |
| `users` | `object[] \| null` | No | List of all workspace users. |
| `identities` | `any \| null` | No | The identities that can be assigned or mentioned in the workspace. |
| `identities_count` | `any \| null` | No | The number of identities in the workspace. |
| `order` | `number \| null` | No | The requesting user's order within the workspace users. |
| `permissions` | `any \| null` | No | The requesting user's permissions for the workspace. |
| `unread_notifications_count` | `number \| null` | No | The number of unread notifications for the requesting user. |
| `generative_ai_models_enabled` | `any \| null` | No | Generative AI models available in this workspace. |
| `ai_features` | `any \| null` | No | — |

### delete

`workspaces.delete`

Deletes an existing workspace if the authorized user belongs to the workspace. All the applications, databases, tables etc that were in the workspace are going to be deleted also.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.workspaces.delete({ workspace_id: 101 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `clientUndoRedoActionGroupId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Deletes the workspace related to the provided value. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Baserow accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### exportApplicationsAsync

`workspaces.exportApplicationsAsync`

Export workspace or set of applications application if the authorized user is in the application's workspace. All the related children are also going to be exported. For example in case of a database application all the underlying tables, fields, views and rows are going to be exported.Roles are….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.workspaces.exportApplicationsAsync({ workspace_id: 101 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `clientSessionId` | `string` | No | An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone. |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | The id of the workspace that must be exported. |



**Output**

| `exported_file_name` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `workspace_id` | `number \| null \| null` | No | The workspace that the applications are going to be exported from. |

### invitationLinks.create

`workspaces.invitationLinks.create`

Creates a new permanent invitation link if the authorized user has admin rights to the related workspace. Anyone with the link can join the workspace with the permissions of the link until the link is deleted. Links can't be created while both new signups and signups via workspace invitations….

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.baserow.api.workspaces.invitationLinks.create({ workspace_id: 101, permissions: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `workspace_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Creates an invitation link to the workspace related to the provided value. |
| `name` | `string` | No | A name that reminds the admins what the link is for. |
| `permissions` | `string` | Yes | The permissions that people get within the workspace when they join through the link, or on the scope of the link if it has one. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `workspace` | `number \| null` | No | The workspace that people join through the link. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | A name that reminds the admins what the link is for. |
| `slug` | `string \| null` | No | The unique slug of the public link URL. |
| `permissions` | `any \| null` | No | — |
| `has_password` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether people must enter a password before they can use the link. |
| `created_on` | `string \| null` | No | — |



---
